Question 7
?

Given that u=2x−1, which integral is equivalent to ∫13x2x−1dx?

a
14∫15udu
b
12∫13udu
c
14∫15(u3/2+u1/2)du
d
12∫15(u1/2+u−1/2)du
e
12∫13(u3/2+u1/2)du
